headline: Depositors Protest Outside Central Bank of Paraguay Over Frozen Bank Accounts
summary: Account holders staged protests outside the Central Bank of Paraguay in Asunción, demanding full reimbursement of deposits frozen since Ueno Bank's issues emerged on Nov 3.
why: Banking deposit freezes threaten consumer liquidity and public trust in financial regulatory authorities.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Banking sector protests highlighted customer concerns over frozen funds.
